_note: Đề luyện TOEIC Reading tự biên soạn bởi nhóm 8. Không sao chép đề thương mại. Đánh số câu 101–200 như đề thật; Part 6 đánh dấu chỗ trống trong đoạn văn bằng (số câu).
title: Đề luyện Reading tự biên soạn số 3
description: Đề Reading đầy đủ 100 câu (Part 5: 30, Part 6: 16, Part 7: 54) trong 75 phút. Nội dung tự biên soạn để luyện tập, không phải đề chính thức của ETS.

part5.q: The new software makes it _____ for staff to track their travel expenses.
part5.explanation: make it + tính từ: easier (dễ hơn).

part5.q: By the time the auditors arrive next Monday, the finance team _____ all of the receipts.
part5.explanation: By the time + hiện tại đơn (nói về tương lai) → mệnh đề chính dùng tương lai hoàn thành.

part5.q: Applications for the summer internship must be submitted _____ May 15.
part5.explanation: by + mốc thời gian = hạn chót, không muộn hơn ngày 15/5.

part5.q: Ms. Alvarez asked that all reports be sent directly to _____ by Friday.
part5.explanation: Sau giới từ to cần đại từ tân ngữ: her.

part5.q: Due to heavy rain, the outdoor company picnic has been _____ until next Saturday.
part5.explanation: Hoãn sang thứ Bảy tuần sau: postponed (trì hoãn).

part5.q: _____ the shipment was delayed, the store opened on schedule.
part5.explanation: Hai vế tương phản (hàng trễ nhưng vẫn khai trương đúng hẹn) → Although.

part5.q: Our customer service team responds to inquiries _____ and politely.
part5.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ responds, song song với politely: promptly.

part5.q: Before signing the lease, please _____ careful attention to the cancellation terms.
part5.explanation: Cụm cố định pay attention to (chú ý tới).

part5.q: Mr. Chen _____ for the company since it opened its first branch in 2015.
part5.explanation: since + mốc thời gian → hiện tại hoàn thành: has worked.

part5.q: The hotel offers a complimentary shuttle that _____ guests to and from the airport.
part5.explanation: Xe đưa đón chở khách: transports (vận chuyển).

part5.q: The quarterly sales report will be discussed _____ tomorrow's management meeting.
part5.explanation: Trước cụm danh từ chỉ sự kiện dùng giới từ during; while là liên từ.

part5.q: The marketing director was impressed by the _____ of the proposal submitted by the design team.
part5.explanation: Sau mạo từ the và trước of cần danh từ: originality (tính độc đáo).

part5.q: Employees who wish to attend the workshop should add _____ names to the list by Thursday.
part5.explanation: Trước danh từ names cần tính từ sở hữu: their.

part5.q: Please call the front desk _____ you need extra towels or pillows.
part5.explanation: Điều kiện: gọi lễ tân nếu cần thêm khăn → if.

part5.q: All visitors must present a valid photo ID in order to _____ access to the research laboratory.
part5.explanation: Cụm cố định gain access to (được vào).

part5.q: The renovation of the lobby _____ by the end of next month.
part5.explanation: Chủ ngữ là việc cải tạo (bị hoàn thành) và mốc tương lai → bị động tương lai: will be completed.

part5.q: Ms. Patel gave a very _____ presentation on reducing energy costs.
part5.explanation: Sau very và trước danh từ presentation cần tính từ: informative.

part5.q: The conference room is located _____ the end of the hallway on the third floor.
part5.explanation: Cụm at the end of (ở cuối).

part5.q: Mr. Okafor was asked to _____ the new employees during their first week.
part5.explanation: Giám sát nhân viên mới: supervise.

part5.q: The project will be finished on time _____ the supplier delivers the materials as promised.
part5.explanation: provided that = với điều kiện là; in case of đi với danh từ.

part5.q: Recent surveys show that customers are increasingly _____ about the environmental impact of packaging.
part5.explanation: be concerned about = lo ngại về; sau are cần tính từ.

part5.q: The board voted to _____ a new policy on remote work beginning in July.
part5.explanation: adopt a policy = thông qua, áp dụng chính sách; adapt = điều chỉnh.

part5.q: If the order had been placed earlier, the furniture _____ before the grand opening.
part5.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 3 (giả định quá khứ): would have + V3.

part5.q: Ticket prices vary _____ the seating section.
part5.explanation: Giá vé thay đổi tùy theo khu ghế: according to.

part5.q: Please keep your receipt as _____ of purchase.
part5.explanation: proof of purchase = bằng chứng mua hàng; cần danh từ.

part5.q: Of the three applicants interviewed, Ms. Kim was the one _____ experience best matched the job description.
part5.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ sở hữu đứng trước danh từ experience: whose.

part5.q: The updated schedule will be _____ distributed to all department heads on Monday.
part5.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho phân từ distributed: electronically.

part5.q: Customers can _____ their loyalty points for discounts at any of our locations.
part5.explanation: redeem points = đổi điểm thưởng.

part5.q: Ms. Lopez will lead the training session, _____ Mr. Grant will handle registration.
part5.explanation: Nối hai mệnh đề diễn ra song song: while; during/despite/because of đi với danh từ.

part5.q: The factory manager is responsible for ensuring that all safety regulations are strictly _____.
part5.explanation: enforce regulations = thực thi quy định; strictly enforced là cụm thường gặp.

part6.title: Article · City bike lanes
part6.instructions: Questions 143-146 refer to the following article.

passage.title: City bike lanes
passage.content:
FAIRVIEW (May 12) — The city of Fairview announced on Monday that it will add twelve kilometers of new bike lanes downtown. Construction is expected to begin in June and (143) _____ about four months.

City officials hope the project will reduce traffic and encourage residents to use bicycles for short trips. "Many people already ride to work," said transportation director Laura Kim. "(144) _____."

Some business owners have expressed concern that the work could make it (145) _____ for customers to reach their shops. In response, the city has promised to keep at least one lane open on every street during construction. A public meeting about the project will be held on May 20 at City Hall. Residents are (146) _____ to attend and share their ideas.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (143).
questions.explanation: Song song với begin sau is expected to: to begin and (to) last.

options: Safer lanes will make it easier for even more of them to do so.
The city hall building will be repainted next year.
Bicycles are sold at several downtown stores.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (145).
questions.explanation: make it + tính từ + for sb to V: difficult.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (146).
questions.explanation: be encouraged to attend = được khuyến khích tham dự.

part7.title: Text message chain · Print shop
part7.instructions: Questions 147-148 refer to the following text-message chain.

passages.content:
Nora Park (10:05 A.M.): Hi Sam, are you still at the print shop?
Sam Ortiz (10:06 A.M.): Yes, I'm picking up the brochures for the trade show.
Nora Park (10:07 A.M.): Could you also get 50 extra business cards for Mr. Grant? He ran out yesterday.
Sam Ortiz (10:09 A.M.): Sure. They said it takes about twenty minutes, so I'll be back a little after eleven.

questions.q: Why is Mr. Ortiz at the print shop?

questions.q: At 10:10 A.M., what does Ms. Park mean when she writes, "That works"?
options: She thinks the machine is fixed.
She wants Mr. Ortiz to start a new job.
She has finished her work early.
questions.explanation: Sam về muộn hơn 11 giờ; Nora trả lời "No problem. That works" = đồng ý chờ.

part7.title: Letter · Price change
part7.instructions: Questions 159-161 refer to the following letter.

passages.title: Price change
passages.content:
Dear Ms. Taylor,

Thank you for being a loyal customer of Sunrise Water Delivery for the past three years. We are writing to let you know that, beginning March 1, the price of a five-gallon bottle will increase from $7.50 to $8.25. This change is due to higher transportation costs.

However, customers who pay for six months of service in advance will continue to receive the current price until the end of the year. To take advantage of this offer, simply call our office at 555-0140 before February 28.

We appreciate your business.

Sincerely,
Marcus Bell
Customer Relations Manager

questions.q: Why was the letter sent?
options: To thank a customer for a referral
To inform a customer about a price increase
To announce a new delivery schedule
To apologize for a late delivery
questions.explanation: Thư báo giá bình nước tăng từ $7.50 lên $8.25.

questions.q: What reason is given for the change?
options: The company has moved its office.
questions.explanation: "due to higher transportation costs" = chi phí vận chuyển tăng.

questions.q: How can Ms. Taylor keep paying $7.50 per bottle?
options: By paying for half a year of service in advance
By ordering more bottles each month
By picking up the bottles herself
questions.explanation: Trả trước sáu tháng (half a year) thì giữ giá cũ đến cuối năm.

part7.title: Article · New factory
part7.instructions: Questions 162-165 refer to the following article.

passages.title: Lumen Electronics to open factory
passages.content:
GLENDALE (August 5) — Lumen Electronics, a manufacturer of energy-saving light bulbs, announced yesterday that it will open a new factory in Glendale next spring. The factory is expected to create about 250 jobs, most of them in production and quality control.

Company president Hannah Reid said Glendale was chosen because of its skilled workforce and its location near major highways. "Our products are shipped all over the country, so good roads are essential," she explained.

Lumen Electronics was founded twelve years ago in a small garage. Today it sells its products in more than 4,000 stores. The company also plans to offer training programs at Glendale Community College to prepare local residents for the new positions. Hiring will begin in January.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
options: The opening of a community college
A new type of light bulb
The retirement of a company president
A company's plan to build a new facility
questions.explanation: Bài viết chủ yếu nói Lumen Electronics sẽ mở nhà máy mới ở Glendale.

questions.q: According to Ms. Reid, why was Glendale selected?
options: The local government offered tax benefits.
questions.explanation: Bà Reid nhắc vị trí gần các xa lộ lớn và đường sá tốt.

questions.q: The word "essential" in paragraph 2, line 3, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: essential = thiết yếu, cần thiết → necessary.

questions.q: What will happen in January?
options: The company will start recruiting workers.
questions.explanation: "Hiring will begin in January" → bắt đầu tuyển dụng.

part7.title: Online chat · Client presentation
part7.instructions: Questions 166-169 refer to the following online chat discussion.

passages.content:
Grace Hill (2:01 P.M.): Hi team, the client from Brightway Travel just moved our presentation from Thursday to Wednesday morning.
Omar Siddiqui (2:03 P.M.): That gives us one less day. The slides are about 80 percent done.

Omar Siddiqui (2:05 P.M.): Great. I'll add the customer survey results tomorrow morning.

questions.q: What change did the client make?
options: It asked for a different presenter.
questions.explanation: Khách hàng dời buổi thuyết trình từ thứ Năm sang sáng thứ Tư.

questions.q: What will Ms. Cho do tonight?
questions.explanation: Bà Cho sẽ làm xong phần ngân sách (budget section) của bộ slide tối nay.

questions.q: At 2:06 P.M., what does Ms. Hill mean when she writes, "Let's do a practice run"?
options: The team should go for a run together.
The team should rehearse the presentation.
The team should test a new product.
The team should leave work early.
questions.explanation: practice run = buổi tập dượt trước khi thuyết trình thật.

questions.q: Why will Ms. Hill book Room C?
options: Room C is larger than Room B.
Equipment in another room is broken.
questions.explanation: Máy chiếu phòng B hỏng nên bà Hill đổi sang phòng C.

part7.title: E-mail · Heating inspection

questions.q: How often is the inspection carried out?

part7.title: Article · Local bakery
part7.instructions: Questions 173-175 refer to the following article.

passages.title: Local Business Spotlight
passages.content:
Local Business Spotlight: Pine Street Bakery

When Elena Ruiz opened Pine Street Bakery ten years ago, she sold only bread and coffee. Today the bakery offers more than forty kinds of pastries and employs fifteen people. Ms. Ruiz credits her success to listening to customers. "Many of our most popular items were suggested by regular customers," she said.

Last year, the bakery began supplying sandwiches to three nearby office buildings. Ms. Ruiz now plans to open a second location on Maple Avenue this fall. The new shop will include a seating area where customers can enjoy their food on site.

questions.q: What is stated about Pine Street Bakery?
options: It was opened by a group of chefs.
It has recently reduced its staff.
questions.explanation: Từ chỉ bánh mì và cà phê nay có hơn 40 loại bánh → mặt hàng đa dạng hơn.

questions.q: According to Ms. Ruiz, how were some products developed?
questions.explanation: "Many of our most popular items were suggested by regular customers."

questions.q: What will be different about the new location?
options: It will have space for eating in.
It will be run by a new owner.
questions.explanation: Cửa hàng mới có khu ghế ngồi để ăn tại chỗ (seating area).

options: To invite staff to a holiday party
To give details about a training program
questions.explanation: E-mail giới thiệu tuần định hướng (orientation) cho nhân viên mới.

questions.q: What should the new staff bring to every session?
questions.explanation: "Please bring your employee ID card to every session."

questions.q: On which day will the session take place at Harbor Road?
questions.explanation: Buổi thứ Năm học ở văn phòng Harbor Road; lịch cho biết thứ Năm là 15/1.

questions.q: On which day will lunch NOT be provided?
options: The day of the meeting with team managers
The day of computer systems training
The day of customer service training
The day of the claims department visit
questions.explanation: Không có bữa trưa vào thứ Sáu; theo lịch, thứ Sáu là buổi gặp quản lý nhóm.

questions.q: How long is the customer service session?
questions.explanation: Customer service skills từ 13:00 đến 16:00 = 3 giờ.

part7.title: Job posting and e-mail · Bookkeeper
part7.instructions: Questions 181-185 refer to the following job posting and e-mail.

passages.title: Now Hiring
passages.content:
Now Hiring: Part-Time Bookkeeper

Carson & Wells Architects is looking for a part-time bookkeeper to manage invoices, payroll, and monthly reports. The position requires 20 hours per week, with flexible hours. Applicants must have at least two years of bookkeeping experience and be familiar with QuickLedger accounting software. Send your résumé to jobs@carsonwells.com by March 15.

passages.title: Bookkeeper position
passages.content:
To: jobs@carsonwells.com
From: Tom Becker
Date: March 10
Subject: Bookkeeper position

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the part-time bookkeeper position advertised on your Web site. For the past three years, I have handled payroll and invoices for a small design firm, where I used QuickLedger every day. I am currently taking evening classes in accounting, so a schedule with flexible hours would suit me well.

My résumé is attached. I look forward to hearing from you.

Sincerely,
Tom Becker

questions.q: What is one of the duties of the position?
questions.explanation: Công việc gồm hóa đơn, lương và báo cáo hằng tháng (monthly reports).

questions.q: How many hours per week is the job?
questions.explanation: "The position requires 20 hours per week."

questions.q: Why is Mr. Becker interested in flexible hours?
options: He is studying in the evenings.
He lives far from the office.
He takes care of his children.
questions.explanation: Ông đang học lớp kế toán buổi tối nên cần giờ làm linh hoạt.

questions.q: Which requirement of the position does Mr. Becker meet?
options: He has used the required software.
He has worked at an architecture firm.
He has a degree in accounting.
He has managed a large team.
questions.explanation: Tin tuyển dụng yêu cầu biết QuickLedger; ông Becker dùng QuickLedger hằng ngày.

questions.q: What is indicated about Mr. Becker's application?
options: It was sent before the deadline.
It was sent on the deadline.
It was sent after the deadline.
It was sent by regular mail.
questions.explanation: Hạn nộp 15/3; ông gửi ngày 10/3 qua e-mail.

part7.title: Notice, form and e-mail · Community garden
part7.instructions: Questions 186-190 refer to the following notice, form, and e-mail.

passages.title: Plot rental
passages.content:
Lakeside Community Garden — Plot Rental

Garden plots are available for the spring season (April 1 – September 30). Small plots (2 m × 3 m) cost $40, and large plots (3 m × 4 m) cost $65. Residents of Lakeside receive a $10 discount on either size. Water and basic tools are included. Applications are accepted until March 20 and are processed in the order they are received.

passages.title: Plot Application Form
passages.content:
Plot Application Form
Name: Amelia Grant
Address: 14 Lakeside Drive, Lakeside
Plot size: Large
Payment enclosed: $55
Date submitted: March 18
Comments: I would prefer a plot close to the water tap, if possible.

passages.title: Your plot
passages.content:
To: Amelia Grant
From: Garden Office
Date: March 22
Subject: Your plot

Dear Ms. Grant,

Thank you for your application. We are happy to confirm that you have been assigned plot 12. Unfortunately, all plots near the water tap had already been taken, but plot 12 is next to the tool shed. Our opening day will be held on April 1 at 9:00 A.M., when you can collect your key to the garden gate.

Garden Office

questions.q: What is included in the rental price?
questions.explanation: "Water and basic tools are included."

questions.q: Why did Ms. Grant pay $55?
questions.explanation: Ô lớn giá $65, cư dân Lakeside được giảm $10; địa chỉ của bà ở Lakeside → $55.

questions.q: What did Ms. Grant request?
options: A specific location for her plot
questions.explanation: Bà muốn ô gần vòi nước (close to the water tap).

questions.q: What is suggested about Ms. Grant's request?
options: It was sent to the wrong office.
questions.explanation: Các ô gần vòi nước đã hết; bà được xếp ô 12 cạnh nhà kho dụng cụ.

questions.q: What will Ms. Grant receive on April 1?
questions.explanation: Ngày khai mạc 1/4 bà nhận chìa khóa cổng vườn.

part7.title: Web page, review and e-mail · Hotel meetings
part7.instructions: Questions 191-195 refer to the following Web page, review, and e-mail.

passages.title: Meeting packages
passages.content:
Bayside Hotel — Meeting Packages

Standard Package: meeting room, projector, and coffee break — $45 per person
Premium Package: Standard Package plus buffet lunch and free Wi-Fi for all guests — $70 per person

Groups of 30 or more receive a free upgrade from the Standard Package to the Premium Package.
All bookings must be confirmed two weeks before the event.

passages.title: Review by Karen Doyle
passages.content:
Review by Karen Doyle, Orion Software — 4 out of 5 stars

We held our annual planning meeting at the Bayside Hotel in May. There were 34 of us, and the staff were friendly and professional. The buffet lunch was excellent, and the room had a beautiful view of the harbor. My only complaint is that the projector stopped working twice during the morning session.

passages.title: Your review
passages.content:
To: Karen Doyle
From: Victor Chan, Events Manager, Bayside Hotel
Date: May 28
Subject: Your review

Dear Ms. Doyle,

Thank you for your kind review. I am sorry about the problem with the projector. We have since replaced all of the projectors in our meeting rooms. To show our appreciation, we would like to offer Orion Software a 15 percent discount on your next booking with us.

Sincerely,
Victor Chan

questions.q: What is included in the Premium Package but not in the Standard Package?
questions.explanation: Gói Premium thêm buffet lunch (bữa trưa) và Wi-Fi.

questions.q: What is suggested about Orion Software's meeting?
options: It received a free package upgrade.
It was booked one day in advance.
It took place at a different hotel.
questions.explanation: Nhóm 34 người (từ 30 trở lên) được nâng cấp miễn phí; bài đánh giá có nhắc buffet lunch của gói Premium.

questions.q: What did Ms. Doyle dislike?
questions.explanation: Máy chiếu ngừng hoạt động hai lần.

questions.q: What has the hotel done since Ms. Doyle's visit?
questions.explanation: "We have since replaced all of the projectors."

questions.q: What does Mr. Chan offer?
options: A free night at the hotel
A reduced price on a future event
questions.explanation: Giảm 15% cho lần đặt tiếp theo.

part7.title: Notice, schedule and e-mail · E-mail upgrade
part7.instructions: Questions 196-200 refer to the following notice, schedule, and e-mail.

passages.title: IT Announcement
passages.content:
IT Announcement — E-mail system upgrade

Our company e-mail system will be upgraded to a new version this month. To reduce disruption, the upgrade will be done one department at a time. Each department's e-mail will be unavailable for approximately three hours on its scheduled date. Staff will receive a reminder the day before.

passages.title: Upgrade Schedule
passages.content:
Upgrade Schedule
Accounting — Monday, June 9, 6:00–9:00 P.M.
Human Resources — Tuesday, June 10, 6:00–9:00 P.M.
Sales — Wednesday, June 11, 6:00–9:00 P.M.
Marketing — Thursday, June 12, 6:00–9:00 P.M.

passages.title: Upgrade date
passages.content:
To: IT Help Desk
From: Julia Romano
Date: June 4
Subject: Upgrade date

Hello,

I work in the Sales department. On the evening of our scheduled upgrade, I will be sending price quotes to an important client in Tokyo, where it will already be morning. Would it be possible to move our department's upgrade to the following evening instead? Marketing has told me they would be happy to switch dates with us.

Thank you,
Julia Romano

questions.q: Why was the notice written?
options: To introduce a new IT manager
To ask staff to buy new computers
To announce a change in working hours
To explain how a system update will be done
questions.explanation: Thông báo giải thích việc nâng cấp e-mail làm lần lượt từng phòng ban.

questions.q: How long will each department be without e-mail?
questions.explanation: "unavailable for approximately three hours"

questions.q: When is Ms. Romano's department scheduled for the upgrade?
questions.explanation: Bà Romano làm ở phòng Sales; lịch của Sales là thứ Tư 11/6.

questions.q: Why does Ms. Romano want to change the date?
options: She will be on a business trip.
She is unfamiliar with the new system.
She needs to contact a client overseas.
questions.explanation: Tối hôm đó bà phải gửi báo giá cho khách hàng ở Tokyo.

questions.q: If the request is approved, when will the Sales department's upgrade take place?
questions.explanation: Đổi lịch với Marketing (tối hôm sau) → tối thứ Năm 12/6.
